name: get_voicemails
title: Get Voicemails
description: List voicemails synced from iPhone to this Mac, newest first, with sender, date, duration, read state, transcript availability and audio file path.

sender.description: Filter by sender phone number; partial match, formatting ignored for numbers

start.description: Only voicemails received at or after this ISO 8601 date/time

end.description: Only voicemails received before this ISO 8601 date/time

limit.description: Maximum voicemails to return (default 30, capped at 200)

name: get_transcript
title: Get Voicemail Transcript
description: Get the transcribed text of one voicemail by its id, as returned by get_voicemails.

name: get_audio
title: Get Voicemail Audio
description: Get the audio recording of one voicemail by its id. Returns the file path, copying the file somewhere easy to use when the original is not directly readable.

destination.description: Optional absolute path to copy the audio file to
